samples.question: The top row shows four block shapes, each made of four squares and each painted a different color. The bottom row shows the same four shapes in gray: they appear in a different left-to-right order and each one has been turned by a quarter, half, or three-quarter turn, but none of them was mirrored or resized. Exactly one gray shape is enclosed in a black rectangular frame. Which color is the framed shape in the top row? Answer with red, blue, green, or orange.
